finding: Each per-sandbox net gateway resolves the SPACE local role accounts dev and deploy by name (peer_auth.rs default_local_role_accounts). On GCE an unknown name falls through to the OS Login NSS module, which connects to 169.254.169.254:80; the gateway's sandbox network cannot reach it. strace showed the gateway main thread in 1 s poll loops for about 9 s while its control server could not answer, so the sandbox manager's readiness refresh succeeded only on its 8.88 s retry.

evidence.grpcurl_refresh_during_boot: context deadline exceeded for about 6 s after the control socket appeared, then NETWORK_STATE_READY
evidence.strace: openat /etc/passwd, systemd userdb, /etc/oslogin_passwd.cache.bin, then connect 169.254.169.254:80 EINPROGRESS and poll(..., 1000) timeouts; userdb lookups name deploy.user
evidence.thread_states: main thread in poll_schedule_timeout for 9.1 s after start, tokio workers idle

fix: Locked nologin system accounts dev and deploy on the worker (host-prerequisites.sh, commit 1668c41a3c). No process runs as them.
note: The network policy generation conflict event still appears and does not delay readiness.
